generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table, never NULL; PK values stay unique across compact and generated rows.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Sample from the parent PK pool; for composite FKs sample the whole tuple from the parent's existing key tuples; leave at least one parent row with no children; only nullable FKs receive NULLs; NOT NULL FKs never get NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_name: Random first+last name from a fixed name pool; include near-duplicate variants (case change, appended suffix, one-character substitution) and duplicates on DISTINCT columns.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_phone: Random phone format from a fixed pool of formats; allow duplicates; plant NULLs only in columns declared nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.char_code: Sample from the table's enum pool; include case variants for equality literals.
generic_sampling_rules.date: Random date in 2015-01-01..2019-12-31 formatted %Y-%m-%d; allow duplicates on DISTINCT date columns; when a row-level start/end pair exists, the end date is later than the start.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary: For each listed literal, include the literal and one step on each side (numbers by step 1, dates by 1 day, strings by case/suffix change).
generic_sampling_rules.near_variant: For each listed LIKE/equality literal, deterministically plant the literal plus every listed case, suffix and one-character variant (at least one row each) before random filling.
generic_sampling_rules.tie: Ensure at least two groups share the top value of the ORDER aggregate (COUNT(*) or COUNT(DISTINCT child.col)) at the listed rank.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: Distribute child rows so that some parents have 1 child, some 2, and some >= 3 children.
generic_sampling_rules.aggregate_boundary: Plant groups whose COUNT crosses each listed boundary value (e.g. 3, 4, 5) so HAVING COUNT > k is true for some groups and false for others.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For nullable columns, replace 5-30% of sampled values with NULL (at least one per column); never replace a NULL to satisfy a rule.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_share: Use at least 20% fresh values not drawn from the compact sample for free-sampled columns.
generic_sampling_rules.fk_validation: Re-enable FK enforcement in the writer (or run an explicit post-generation FK check) and fail loudly on any violation; never silently commit FK violations.
